mechanism_narrative: An increase in GDP (GDPC1) indicates strong economic demand, which should positively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If GDP growth is positive but S&P 500 returns are negative over the 20-day horizon in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If the unemployment rate falls below 4% but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 50% of the next 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: Low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with falling unemployment (UNRATE) indicates an accommodative monetary policy, boosting S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If both conditions are met but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) during an expansionary regime suggests strong supply activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If industrial production grows but S&P 500 returns are negative over the next 60 days in more than 30% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates tighter monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns as borrowing costs increase.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS exceeds 2% but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of the next 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200 indicates strong demand in the housing market, positively impacting S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If housing starts exceed 1200 but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: High retail sales (RSAFS) combined with strong employment (PAYEMS) indicates robust demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If both conditions are met but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 30% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, low unemployment (UNRATE) may not prevent negative S&P 500 returns as other macro factors dominate.
failure_condition: If UNRATE remains low but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of the next 60 days.
